app_fee.value: No single fee for all PhDs: each college sets its own, and the program records give it.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are limited in number, and you must start an application to be considered.
fee_waiver.quote: There are a limited number of fee waivers offered each year. You must start an application in the system to be considered for a fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The graduate school sets no single GRE rule, so each program record gives its college or department rule.

toefl_min.value: Minimums are set by college, so each program record gives its own.

ielts_min.value: Minimums are set by college, so each program record gives its own.

english_waiver.value: An India degree taught in English waives the test only if the transcript shows English as the medium of instruction and you were physically in India for two consecutive years.
english_waiver.quote: will have earned the international equivalent of a U.S. degree from a college or university located in a country where English is an official language, and where English is the language of instruction ... | The medium of instruction must be indicated on the transcript or easily verified on the institution’s website.

also.quote: physically present in the country of study for a minimum of 2 consecutive years

notes: Each college sets its own fee, GRE and test minimums. Arts & Sciences: $50 fee, TOEFL iBT composite 94 (old scale), IELTS overall 6.5. Rossin Engineering: $50 fee, TOEFL iBT 81 (old scale) or 4 (new scale), IELTS overall 6.5, GRE not considered. Indian citizens also qualify outright under the citizenship path, which lists India. Not mapped to a field: the Industrial and Systems Engineering PhD (Rossin), the Population Health PhD (College of Health) and the Psychology PhD (Arts & Sciences).
